entries.186962082cf2dc8c: It sells scientific computing computers that achieve ultra-high-speed, large-scale and high-precision calculations by building and tuning computing programs to suit uses such as scientific computing, simulation, computational chemistry and deep learning. entries.826bebc7a4dfcf63: This business provides solutions for scientific computing computers. In addition to selling high-performance computers with system integration tailored to customers' intended uses, it provides software program development and sales, contract computing and R&D support, and post-installation support on a one-stop basis. It has strengths in computational chemistry, and its focus areas are life science and materials science. A consolidated subsidiary in Vietnam also handles system sales and other operations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,000 million.

entries.a5c4fa1c75e7eb47: The business model involves building and selling scientific computing computers for research and development at universities and companies, and providing industrial computers designed to customer specifications through an integrated service covering design, mass production and maintenance, for which the company receives payment.
entries.a85d0c99bab7c4b3: In addition to developing, selling and supporting original software programs for scientific computing, it also undertakes contract scientific computing and technical support, provides program acceleration services, and holds seminars on computational science.
entries.ad95c2a9335eaa9a: Customers of the HPC Business are university laboratories, public research institutions and R&D departments of companies, while customers of the CTO Business are equipment manufacturers that make manufacturing equipment and medical devices.
entries.aecac0e2c2a857c8: Under its medium-term management plan 'Vision2027,' the company says it is building a structure to provide one-stop computing solutions covering everything from 'supercomputers to edge computers,' and it aims to differentiate itself through synergies between its business divisions, with R&D DX and manufacturing and non-manufacturing DX as strategic fields.
entries.b04f482830903710: The business develops, manufactures and sells industrial computers built to customers' specified orders. As embedded computers, they are installed in manufacturing equipment, machine tools, measuring and inspection equipment, monitoring and control of infrastructure systems, medical devices, digital signage and other products. The company has an integrated structure covering everything from specification design and prototyping to mass production and post-shipment support, and supports long-term stable supply of products with the same specifications. Manufacturing is carried out at the company's domestic plant in Sosa, Chiba Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,905 million.

entries.c7014b382a2a36ea: In the HPC Business, the company provides one-stop service from hardware to software, entrusted computation and technical support, building on its expertise in computational chemistry and its long-standing relationships with university laboratories, public research institutions and corporate R&D departments. The CTO Business is characterized by an integrated structure covering specification design, mass production and post-shipment maintenance, as well as parts procurement capability that allows it to supply industrial computers of the same specification stably over a long period.
